title: Design System: Crossed Over Citi Church

display.purpose: The hero headline only; clamp(3.5rem, 5.4vw, 6rem) at 1024px and up.

display-stack.purpose: Stacked pillar words, one per line.

headline.purpose: Section headings; the closing violet band runs larger at clamp(2.25rem, 5vw, 4.25rem).

headline-rail.purpose: Heading beside a poster rail's arrow controls.

title.purpose: Sermon and event titles, FAQ questions, form headings.

title-poster.purpose: Uppercase ministry names on poster cards; the only capitals in Poppins.

lead.purpose: Hero and band supporting copy, 44ch to 56ch.

label.purpose: Buttons, nav links, field labels, footer headings.

caption.purpose: Helper text, time stamps, legal line.

script.purpose: The Cebuano welcome line and its footer echo only; brand-sourced from the church banner.

shadows.name: ring-hairline
shadows.purpose: The only box-shadow: a 1px ring in the line color separating the hero stage, the This Sunday tile and the visit form from the ground. No drop shadows exist.

motion.name: ease-expo-out
motion.purpose: Shared curve for the hero entrance and the poster image zoom.

motion.name: unveil
motion.purpose: Hero stage entrance; only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Hero headline, lead, actions and This Sunday tile; only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

motion.name: state-color
motion.purpose: Hover transitions on colors, borders, fills and arrow gap (8px to 12px).

motion.name: header-settle
motion.purpose: Header gains hairline rule and backdrop blur after 8px of scroll.

motion.name: rail-step
motion.value: scrollBy 80% of rail width, smooth unless reduced motion

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The gold pill for the one action, Plan your visit; the arrow gap opens on hover.
components.html: Plan your visit
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--gold); color: var(--on-gold); padding: 14px 28px; font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 300ms, gap 300ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--gold-hover); gap: 12px; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary pill with a translucent white border, for watching online or directions.
components.html: Watch online
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3); background: transparent; color: var(--text); padding: 14px 28px; font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 300ms, background-color 300ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: 44px circular control used for rail arrows and the mobile menu; disables at rail ends.
components.css: .ds-btn-icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: transparent; color: var(--text); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 300ms, background-color 300ms; } .ds-btn-icon:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); background: var(--raised); } .ds-btn-icon:disabled { opacity: 0.35; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-btn-icon:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Ground-colored well inside the raised form card; stroke turns gold on focus.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text); } .ds-field { width: 100%; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--ground); color: var(--text); padding: 12px 14px; font: inherit; font-weight: 400; transition: border-color 200ms; } .ds-field:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35); } .ds-field:focus { border-color: var(--gold); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Header Navigation
components.description: Slim sticky bar: logo and wordmark left, muted links centered, compact gold pill right.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; height: 72px; padding: 0 24px; background: rgba(11,5,20,0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-mark { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; font-family: Poppins, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text); } .ds-nav-logo { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--violet); } .ds-nav nav { display: flex; gap: 36px; } .ds-nav nav a { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--muted); text-decoration: none; transition: color 300ms; } .ds-nav nav a:hover { color: var(--text); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-nav-cta { border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--gold); color: var(--on-gold); padding: 10px 20px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 300ms; } .ds-nav-cta:hover { background: var(--gold-hover); }

components.name: Poster Card
components.description: 3:4 photograph tile with a ground scrim and an uppercase Poppins name; the photo zooms slightly on hover.
components.html: YouthStudents and young adults growing together.
components.css: .ds-poster { position: relative; display: block; width: 240px; aspect-ratio: 3 / 4; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--raised); color: var(--text); text-decoration: none; } .ds-poster-img { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--violet-deep); transition: transform 700ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-poster:hover .ds-poster-img { transform: scale(1.04); } .ds-poster-scrim { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(11,5,20,0.92) 8%, rgba(11,5,20,0.25) 55%, transparent); } .ds-poster-copy { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; padding: 20px; text-align: center; } .ds-poster-title { display: block; font-family: Poppins, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 1.75rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.01em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-poster-line { display: block; margin-top: 8px; font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.25rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); } .ds-poster:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-rail { color: var(--text); } .ds-rail-head { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; } .ds-rail-title { margin: 0; font-family: Poppins, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 2.25rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: -0.03em; } .ds-rail-ctrl { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-rail-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: transparent; color: var(--text); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 300ms, background-color 300ms; } .ds-rail-btn:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); background: var(--raised); } .ds-rail-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.35; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-rail-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-rail-list { display: flex; gap: 16px; margin: 40px 0 0; padding: 0 0 8px; list-style: none; overflow-x: auto; scroll-snap-type: x mandatory; overscroll-behavior-x: contain; scrollbar-width: none; } .ds-rail-item { flex: 0 0 200px; aspect-ratio: 3 / 4; scroll-snap-align: start; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--raised); display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: center; padding: 20px; font-family: Poppins, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Date Tile
components.description: Square violet tile leading each event row: month in Violet Mist capitals above the day.
components.css: .ds-date { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 88px; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--violet); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-date-m { font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; color: var(--on-violet-muted); } .ds-date-d { font-family: Poppins, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 1.875rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; color: var(--text); }

components.css: .ds-card { border-radius: 16px; background: var(--raised); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--line); padding: 40px; color: var(--text); max-width: 32rem; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-family: Poppins, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.03em; } .ds-card-body { margin: 12px 0 0; font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; line-height: 1.75rem; color: var(--muted); }

components.css: .ds-band { border-radius: 16px; background: var(--violet); color: var(--text); padding: 64px 40px; } .ds-band-title { margin: 0; max-width: 20ch; font-family: Poppins, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 2.75rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.02; letter-spacing: -0.035em; } .ds-band-body { margin: 20px 0 0; font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 2rem; color: var(--on-violet-muted); } .ds-band-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-top: 40px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--gold); color: var(--on-gold); padding: 14px 28px; font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 300ms, gap 300ms; } .ds-band-cta:hover { background: var(--gold-hover); gap: 12px; } .ds-band-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
The page bills Sunday Service the way a tour site bills its headline date: a near-black violet ground, photographs of the church's own people as the only light source, and heavy geometric type set huge and tight across them. The brand violet does not tint text or decorate edges; it takes over whole fields (the closing call band, date tiles, the confirmation panel). Lemon gold is the ticket: it fills the one action that matters, "Plan your visit", and almost nothing else.

Density is low and theatrical. Sections breathe with 80 to 112px of vertical room, media sits in softly rounded cards inset from the viewport edge, and the one signature interaction is a poster rail that scrolls sideways with snap points and arrow controls. The only choreographed motion is the hero's entrance; after that, the page holds still and lets the photographs carry it.

The world rejects the category default of a pastel church brochure with a banner hero and three feature cards. It also rejects the neon excesses of its cinematic reference: no glows, no decorative gradients, no lit edges.
keyCharacteristics: Dark violet-black ground with white type; every token text pairing measures at least 5.6:1.
Brand violet as a field color only; gold as the single action color.
Poppins bold at display sizes with negative tracking; Geist for everything read at length.
One brand-sourced script, reserved for the Cebuano welcome line.
Flat surfaces separated by a 1px hairline ring, never by shadow.
Inset rounded stage for the hero and the closing band; 16px and 12px radii only, pills for controls.
One orchestrated entrance, fully disabled under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Gold Door Rule
rules.body: A gold fill means "come on Sunday". Only the primary action pill wears it. Gold elsewhere is limited to small wayfinding marks and interaction states; never a gold background panel, gold heading, or second gold button with a different job.

rules.name: The Violet Field Rule
rules.body: Brand violet owns whole surfaces or nothing. It never sets text on the dark ground; violet-tinted text uses Lilac Text.

rules.name: The Photographs Are the Light Rule
rules.body: Light comes only from photography. Gradients exist solely as ground-colored scrims that protect text over images; there are no glows, colored gradients, or neon edges.

rules.name: The Headliner Rule
rules.body: Display and headline type is Poppins at 600 to 700 with tracking between -0.02em and -0.035em and line height near 1. Poppins at display size is never set loose or light.

rules.name: The One Script Rule
rules.body: Sacramento sets the Cebuano welcome line ("Kung kinsa man ka, unsa man ka, welcome ka!") and its footer echo, nothing else. It is brand-sourced from the church's banner, not an ornament.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Separation is a 1px ring or rule in the line color, or a tonal step to raised. Never a drop shadow, glow, or colored outline.

dos: Do give the primary action ("Plan your visit") the gold pill with Ink Plum text and a trailing arrow, and keep it the only gold-filled control on screen.
Do set violet as a whole field carrying white text (6.9:1) and Violet Mist secondary text (5.6:1).
Do use Lilac Text when text or a stroke needs a violet tint on the dark ground.
Do set headlines in Poppins 600 to 700 with -0.02em to -0.035em tracking and line height near 1.
Do separate surfaces with the 1px line ring, a hairline rule, or a step from ground to raised.
Do keep radii to 16px (stages, panels), 12px (posters, tiles, fields) and full pills for controls.
Do lay ground-colored scrims over photographs whenever text sits on them.
Do use tabular numerals for times, dates and phone numbers.
Do gate any entrance animation behind prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.
donts: Don't set the brand violet as text or thin strokes on the dark ground (2.9:1).
Don't use gold as a panel fill, heading color, or second button with a different job.
Don't add drop shadows, glows, neon edges, or colored decorative gradients.
Don't use Sacramento for anything but the Cebuano welcome line and its footer echo.
Don't add load motion beyond the hero entrance.
Don't use pills for containers or square corners for controls.
Don't put em dashes in copy.
